messages:
alex.sales: Handing off Pegasus (Enterprise, $1.2M ARR). Signed for Q2 private deployment + SSO + custom billing. Renewal window Apr 2026. Main risks: legal still needs DPA signed, they called out latency concerns and token cost variability. Sales has delivered basic docs and two pilot prompts. Need CSM owner, kickoff, and eng/support touch for private deploy + SSO. Key contacts: carla@pegasus.com (prod lead), ryan@pegasus.com (infra).

sarah.cs: Assigning Jordan as primary CSM. Jordan — can you pick this up? Also flagging renewal timeline so we keep monthly adoption checkpoints. :calendar:

jordan.csm: I can take this. Initial plan: 1) 30m kickoff w/ Pegasus + Sales 2) SSO setup + test 3) Private deploy prep (eng) 4) Load test + latency baseline 5) Weekly health check for first 8 weeks.

jordan.csm: Quick Qs for Sales: do we have the signed DPA in hand? any compliance artifacts already shared? and which model/version did they request for private deploy?

alex.sales: DPA is in legal queue, I uploaded the draft to the shared folder (link). They asked for a 13B instruction-tuned model initially (we recommended 7B quantized as fallback). Also added the two sample prompt templates to the shared drive.

micah.support: I'll open a support case for SSO and billing hookup. Need the customer org ID and the SSO metadata (IdP URL + cert). Creating ticket now.

handoff-bot: Support ticket #CS-2026-314 created: "Pegasus SSO + Billing Hookup" assigned to micah.support.

micah.support: Ticket updated — please attach the IdP metadata and confirm contact: carla@pegasus.com. Also note: we'll ask them to run a short smoke test once SSO is configured.

tayla.eng: I'll own the private deploy prep and infra checklist. Need: model artifact name, expected sustained QPS, KV cache behavior (session lengths), and whether they require KMS/HSM integration. Earliest I can provision a test env is ~2 weeks out.

jordan.csm: Noted. Pegasus expects bursty traffic during daytime windows (estimated 60-80 qps peaks, mostly short prompts). I'll capture those patterns in kickoff and share.

micah.support: FYI I'll log a request for latency trace hooks so we can instrument post-deploy checks.

jordan.csm: Scheduling kickoff Thurs 11am PT with Pegasus + Sales + Eng + Support. I'll send calendar invite and attach an enablement packet: onboarding checklist, playbook, known limitations, success criteria template.

jordan.csm: Owners/next steps summary: Sales -> legal DPA follow-up (alex.sales). CSM Jordan -> kickoff, enablement, adoption tracking. Eng Tayla -> provision test env + private deploy. Support Micah -> SSO & billing ticket and smoke tests. I'll capture feedback items from the kickoff and create a short internal recap after the call.

alex.sales: Thanks team — I'll nudge legal and confirm DPA ETA.

jordan.csm: Quick renewal/health note: putting a checkpoint at 30 days for adoption metrics; if usage <30% of initial forecast we escalate to AM/RevOps to discuss incentives. Will capture all feedback in the enablement doc. :white_check_mark:

handoff-bot: Reminder set: "Pegasus 30-day adoption check" scheduled for 1843920000 (UTC).
